name: CoinGate

evidence.crypto: C01: merchant checkout accepts BTC, ETH, USDC, LTC and other coins on named networks
evidence.links: F16: payment links and dashboard payment requests can be emailed or shared directly

line: Crypto checkout with invoices, payment links and recurring billing.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee; 1% per merchant payment

cells.countries: Published seller list includes UK, Germany and India
cells.payout: Weekly by default; withdrawals usually within hours

fee.math: It isn't confirmed whether US sellers can sign up. The published seller list doesn't show they are excluded.
The standard plan charges 1% on each payment. A risk margin that can vary may also apply.
